claims: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites into low-Earth orbit.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launch was from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launch occurred on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launch occurred just after sunset.
The SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launch was highly visible across Southern California.
Another mission is scheduled to launch from Florida on Wednesday.
